purpose: Reusable point-in-time feature/outcome dataset for regime diagnostics and future scoring mechanisms; this file defines no score.
antiLeakage: Features must be observable by completed close T.
Forward outcomes are labels only and must never be used as same-row features.
Missing historical context remains null; do not reconstruct catalysts, valuation or macro surprises from later knowledge.

cohorts.2025_external_retrospective: Frozen v3.0 external validation; partial feature coverage.
cohorts.canonical_point_in_time: Canonical NasDecode history with context available at T.
